items.gestiegenen: gestiegenen is a Partizip II, „that have risen“. The prices are rising now: Partizip I.
items.steigende: After die in the plural the ending is -n: steigenden.

items.renovierende: Partizip I means „is renovating“. The house was renovated (finished, passive): Partizip II.
items.renoviertes: After das the ending is -e, not -es.

items.prüfende: After die in the plural the ending is -n: prüfenden.
items.geprüften: zu + Partizip I, not Partizip II: zu prüfenden.

items.geschlafenes: Partizip II would not describe a child that is sleeping. Use Partizip I.
items.schlafende: After ein, a neuter noun needs -es: schlafendes.

items.planende: Partizip I means „is planning“. The bridge is planned: Partizip II.
items.geplanten: After die, a feminine singular noun takes -e: geplante.

items.Ankommen: After seiner the usual noun is Ankunft.
items.Angekommen: angekommen is a participle, not a noun.

items.Renovieren: zur needs a feminine noun: Renovierung.
items.Renoviert: renoviert is a participle, not a noun.

items.Planen: After der we need a noun: die Planung.
items.Plan: Plan means „plan“. The act of planning is Planung.

items.Beginnen: Beginnen is the verb. The noun is Beginn.

items.gewarteten: The prefix ge- forms a Partizip II. The guests are waiting now: Partizip I.
items.wartende: After die in the plural the ending is -n: wartenden.

items.stehlende: stehlend means „stealing“. The saddle was stolen: Partizip II.
items.gestohlenen: After der in the Nominativ the ending is -e: gestohlene.
